subject: Norway
note: Cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary): Arctic Circle. Iceland reaches the circle only on the small offshore island of Grímsey; Denmark through Greenland.

claims.text: The land within the Arctic Circle is divided among eight countries: Norway, Sweden, Finland, Russia, the United States (Alaska), Canada, Denmark (Greenland), and Iceland (where it passes through the small offshore island of Grímsey).
The Arctic Circle is shown on maps of Earth at about 66° 34' N.
At least once each year at any location within the Arctic Circle the centre of the Sun is visible at local midnight.
